intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Kaedra warms her hands near a lantern. A passer-by carrying a stack of papers takes the long way around her.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “There is a rumor that I set buildings alight by sneezing.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Only if the building is made of exceptionally nervous paper.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Her nose twitches. The man with the papers breaks into a jog.

options.labelText: “So what do you want to do about it? I could bring pepper.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “A controlled demonstration. I will draft the procedure. You will keep anyone holding paper well back.”

options.labelText: “Lean into it. Puff a little smoke and nobody will bother you again.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Then the rumor would be accurate, and I would have to sign it.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She tucks her hands into her sleeves and moves away from the lantern.
